pool.b.vorstand_budget_antrag_gruss: Good day, I am getting back to you as president about your request.
pool.b.vorstand_budget_antrag_lage: Your request for more transfer budget is on my desk, and the coffers are emptier than we would like.
You want more money for signings, and I have to weigh that against our finances.
pool.b.vorstand_budget_antrag_lage.hitzi: Another demand for money! The budget is tight, and you act as if we had a printing press in the cellar!
Your request comes at the worst time, and I have no patience for wish lists today!
pool.b.vorstand_budget_antrag_lage.loyal: I trust your work and therefore take your request seriously, even though the coffers are thin.
You have the club behind you, I just have to find the money for your request first.
pool.b.vorstand_budget_antrag_lage.ehrge: I want to take this club upwards, and more budget may make sense for that. Convince me that it pays off.
If more money takes us a step further, I am open to it. Your request is here, and I want to see results.
pool.b.vorstand_budget_antrag_lage.wechs: I am considering redistributing the funds anyway, and your request lands right in the middle of that.
Plans change quickly here, and so does financial planning. Your request is here, but whether it still fits is open.
pool.b.vorstand_budget_antrag_lage.sensi: I thought long about how to answer you, because I do not want to offend you: the budget is tight.
Your request weighs on me, and I know how much it means to you, but the situation is difficult.
pool.b.vorstand_saisonziel_gruss: Good day, please take a seat, we have a lot to discuss.
Welcome to the meeting, I have put the season target on the agenda.
pool.b.vorstand_saisonziel_lage: The table shows that we are behind the target we agreed on at the start of the season.
The season target is slipping away, and the board wants to know how things go on.
pool.b.vorstand_saisonziel_lage.hitzig: We are behind the target, and that is unacceptable! The board has had enough of nice explanations!
The table does not lie, and neither do I: the season target is in danger, and I want answers!
pool.b.vorstand_saisonziel_lage.loyal: I stand by you, but the season target is wobbling, and we have to talk about it openly.
We have been on this road together for a long time, so I will say it plainly: the target is wobbling.
pool.b.vorstand_saisonziel_lage.ehrgeizi: I set this club a clear target, and I mean to reach it. Right now it does not look that way.
Whoever wants to reach the top must not run behind, and that is exactly what we are doing.
pool.b.vorstand_saisonziel_lage.wechself: Perhaps the target was wrong from the start, and perhaps so is the coach. We have to clarify that.
I am ready to rethink target, plan and personnel if this continues.
pool.b.vorstand_saisonziel_lage.sensibel: It is not easy for me to bring this up, but the season target is out of reach, and it weighs on all of us.
I do not want to expose anyone, but the situation in the table worries me.
pool.b.verkaufsdruck_vorstand_gruss: Good day, I am writing to you about an unpleasant matter.
Good day, the president here, and it is about money.
pool.b.verkaufsdruck_vorstand_lage: The transfer budget is used up, and the club has to ease the finances. Selling a player would be the quickest way.
We are in the red, and the books demand action. I expect a player to leave the club.
pool.b.verkaufsdruck_vorstand_lage.hitzi: The till is empty, and you sit on wages we cannot afford! One player goes, and soon!
I have had enough of red figures! Sell someone, or I will do it for you!
pool.b.verkaufsdruck_vorstand_lage.loyal: I do not want to interfere in your squad planning, but the finances leave me no choice. A sale must be seriously considered.
You know my attitude towards you. That is precisely why I ask you to help ease the finances.
pool.b.verkaufsdruck_vorstand_lage.ehrge: We can only grow if the balance sheet holds, and right now it does not. A sale makes room for the next investment.
A clever sale today is the signing of tomorrow. What decision are you making?
pool.b.verkaufsdruck_vorstand_lage.wechs: Players come and go, that is the business. I see no reason why one should not go this time as well.
I never planned the squad for eternity anyway. A sale fits our model.
pool.b.verkaufsdruck_vorstand_lage.sensi: I know how close you are to your players, and it is hard for me to ask this. But the figures allow nothing else.
I am uneasy writing this to you, but a sale has become unavoidable.
pool.b.vorstand_lob_serie_gruss: Good day, I am writing to you with pleasure for once.
Good day, the president here, and this time with good news.
pool.b.vorstand_lob_serie_lage: The winning streak is felt throughout the club, and the board is full of praise.
Several wins in a row, that has done us all good, and I want to tell you so personally.
pool.b.vorstand_lob_serie_lage.hitzig: That is finally the performance I wanted to see! Keep it up, and do not let up!
This streak is exactly right, and I expect that it does not break!
pool.b.vorstand_lob_serie_lage.loyal: I always believed in you, and the streak proves me right. The club is proud of you.
I am particularly glad that your work is now bearing fruit, for you have long been loyal to the club.
pool.b.vorstand_lob_serie_lage.ehrgeizig: That is a base on which we can build something great. Now we only have to dare the next step.
With this streak we are in the race, and I want to know how far we can go.
pool.b.vorstand_lob_serie_lage.wechselfr: The streak is pleasing, but I know that in football the wind turns quickly. Let us enjoy it while it lasts.
Success does not last forever, so I am already planning how we can use it before it passes.
pool.b.vorstand_lob_serie_lage.sensibel: Your work has lifted the entire club, and I wanted you to hear that first hand.
It moves me to see how the team has developed, and I want to thank you for it.
